first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports shorter onboarding as a durable way to improve time-to-value and completion. Verifying activation-messaging evidence will help distinguish whether onboarding simplification is the stronger single intervention. Run with downstream qualified-revenue and retention guardrails rather than optimizing completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard onboarding-simplification experiment because onboarding completion is currently down and the verified record shows a durable +13% completion lift, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and +3% 30-day retention. This is stronger evidence for sustainable qualified revenue than activation messaging alone, which produced a smaller retention lift. Monitor qualified pipeline/revenue, activation, and 30-day retention with stop conditions if downstream value deteriorates.
